Scene:
他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好，这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了。神农想找别的植物，但是这很麻烦。正好，他找到了别的花。他一吃花，很快就生病了。他的肚子疼死了。神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 他不知道如果这把花对你的身体好：不知道这种花对身体好不好，the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果
- 这就要看如果这把花毒不毒了：the “if” in “not know if + clause” is not 如果, delete如果，有没有毒
- 正好，他找到了别的花：另外一种花，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”
- 神农不知道他吃不吃灵芝或者夹竹桃：要不要吃……
- 别的人给了神农一个灵芝：另外一个人，“别的” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：他的身体，The narration is about 神农, so the second-person pronoun has no established listener; repeat the named character’s third-person reference instead. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：他的身体，There is no listener addressed as “你”; the flower is being tested by 神农, so this pronoun should refer back to him. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 你的身体：自己的身体，Because the flower’s effect concerns the same person as the subject, use 自己的 to make the possessor clear. [teacher rule: ziji_possessor]

output.reason: All runs identify the inappropriate second-person pronoun 你的, and both 他的身体 and 自己的身体 correctly refer to 神农.
